'''Darek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]], when he was stationed at [[Farnel Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].

==Behind the scenes==
Private Darek appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Equipment Commendations Vendor for Republic players on Balmorra.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Darek was removed from the game along with the rest of the Equipment Commendations Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
